The '''Zuma sector''' was a sector in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], composed of the [[Outer Zuma]] and the [[Inner Zuma Region]]s. The Outer Zuma Region included the [[Kakani sector/Legends|Kakani]], [[Sugai sector/Legends|Sugai]], [[Fusai sector/Legends|Fusai]] and [[Ikenomin sector/Legends|Ikenomin subsectors]], while the Inner Zuma was made up of the [[Spar sector|Spar]], [[Ablajeck sector/Legends|Ablajeck]] and [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell subsectors]]. It contained the planets [[Houche]], [[Abbaji (Spar sector)|Abbaji]], and [[Firrerre/Legends|Firrerre]].

[[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] travels in the little-trafficked Zuma Regions were painfully slow and sometimes unsafe.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
The region was considered part of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] until the final centuries of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. Its subsectors were admitted as [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsector]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] around [[50 BBY/Legends|50 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Zuma sector was eventually created from these freestanding subsectors by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="EAOC" />
